notes: --check never edits quality/findings.json; --update-baseline --reason is the only writer and appends a baseline_edits record.
Identity is the line-independent T1 fingerprint (quality/scanners.json#fingerprint_schemes). New fingerprints fail even when others disappear; bucket counts fail on any increase.
Expiry dates are the last valid day: an exception or gap fails when today > expires.
Accepted gaps are known coverage holes, printed as ACCEPTED GAP / NOT SCANNED and never counted as clean results. --release ignores all accepted gaps.
All owners/expiries below with status proposed-by-T6 need maintainer confirmation (no CODEOWNERS exists; see GAP-no-codeowners).

T7.1: Coverage gaps and exception dispositions require owner, reason, and approval={status: approved, approved_by: reviewer identity, approved_on: YYYY-MM-DD, evidence: review reference}. Proposed or missing approvals fail closed; no approval is inferred from an expiry. Approval must be recorded through review, never by --update-baseline.

needs-triage.meaning: open, unreviewed; tolerated by --check only because it is inventoried

fixed-upstream-verify-regression.meaning: published advisory; release needs regression evidence

informational.meaning: tool diagnostics about analysis coverage, not code findings

accepted_exit_codes._note: Only consulted when run-manifest.json records exit_code. npm audit exits 1 whenever vulnerabilities exist; its failures are detected from the JSON 'error' key. clang-tidy/cppcheck/trivy are forced to exit 0 in CI, so their health comes from report contents (progress lines, crash markers, checkersReport, scan target).

require_run_manifest_note: T14 should emit build/eng-artifacts/<task>/run-manifest.json (exit_code, status, files_scanned, tool_version, db_version per scanner) and then set this to true.
path_renames_format: {"from": "<inventoried path or dir/>", "to": "<current path or dir/>", "reason": "...", "approved_by": "..."}. Observed paths equal to 'to' (or under a 'to' directory ending in '/') are fingerprinted with the 'from' path, so a reviewed rename keeps inventory identity. Remove the entry after an explicit --update-baseline rewrites the inventory with the new paths.

report_pins.reason: T1 retrieved two CodeQL analyses; the inventory was built from analysis 2067529268 @8927bc8a (1b8d4332 has identical rule/path/lineHash keys).

accepted_gaps.reason: GitHub secret scanning is disabled (HTTP 404) and no local secret scanner exists. NOT a clean result; enable it or add a scanner before expiry.
No JS/TS security SAST is configured yet; T14 adds it.
cppcheck runs without a compile database; checkersReport reports critical errors (partial analysis). Findings are still compared; resolved items are reported as unobserved, not fixed.
T1 recorded only the job conclusion (success at 1b8d4332 and 8927bc8a) and did not download the ctest log. Scoped to the T1 report directory only; later report directories must include the log.
